cells.gaps: The survey's measure is adults able to perform at least one of eight digital tasks; the eight tasks are not listed in the source held.
cells.note: NITDA's dashboard counts about 2.76 million people trained across all states, so a programme is in service and counted. NITDA's Nigeria Tech Outlook Report 2026, from a survey of 2,147 households, finds 77.5 per cent of adults able to perform at least one of eight digital tasks, a measured share above half.
